$comment: What bounds a surrogate's scope (ADR 0150 section 8, docs/operators/plugins.md). One definition, two enforcers: the env-spec resolver (crates/env-spec/src/scope.rs) refuses an unbounded `paths=` entry or a method that is not an HTTP method when a schema is read, and the surrogate-proxy plugin (crates/surrogate-proxy/src/plugin/wire.rs) refuses them again on the wire before it issues anything. `bounded` and `unbounded` are path prefixes; `methods.valid` and `methods.invalid` are single method tokens, exact and upper case (the resolver upper-cases a declaration before asking). Each enforcer runs every case below. Change a case here and both must follow.
